body.name: Branch-and-bound certificate handle
body.construction: Work in the deterministic multitape Turing bit model. The input consists of \(n\), the rational log \(e_{n1:n}\), rational outer-enclosure endpoints and protocol constants, \(\alpha\), and \(\xi\), with total binary length \(\Lambda_n\). For every profile-box node \(V\), maintain directed-rational bounds \(L(V)\le\sup_{(q',r')\in V}\mathbb E H_{b,h_n}(Z_{r',q'})\le U(V)\) and the invariant \(U(V)-L(V)\le h_n^{-1}[(2K/c+1)\operatorname{diam}_r(V)+(4KB/c^2+2B/c)\operatorname{diam}_q(V)]+\epsilon_{\mathrm{conv}}(V)\), where the outward convolution error \(\epsilon_{\mathrm{conv}}(V)\) is charged to the remaining rational budget. Prune \(V\) when \(U(V)\le\alpha-\Delta_n\), reject the trial threshold when \(L(V)>\alpha-\Delta_n\), and bisect only boxes whose certified interval straddles \(\alpha-\Delta_n\). The target \(\mathsf{FastCert}_n(e,\alpha,\xi)\) is an outward-valid threshold \(\widetilde a_n\) within \(\xi\) of the exhaustive certificate threshold.
